<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="插件系统五层" id="layers"> <mxGraphModel dx="-484" dy="-232" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="826" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="contract" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;" value="插件契约：name / inject / Config / apply

fiber 状态机：pending → active → disposed
Entry 五步：import / unwrap / inject / apply / rollback" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="340" x="60" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="层 2 装配（profile / bundle）

外部进程参与决策：exit 2 = 拦截
merge：deny > ask > allow 最严格胜出" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="340" x="60" y="550" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="l5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="层 5 类型（typert）

<skill_content> 渲染，懒加载" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="300" x="560" y="430" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ext" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="外部进程参与的决策
hook 进程读快照、写决策，不拿执行权" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="300" x="560" y="560" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="peer" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dbeafe;strokeColor=#2563eb;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;" value="其他进程的调用
host 面 / remote-client 面各自生成" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="300" x="560" y="690" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#64748b;fontColor=#1e293b;fontSize=12;dashed=1;" value="写插件的人只需要懂层 1
装插件的人需要懂层 2
层 3/4/5 是插件暴露给外部世界的三个面" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="300" x="560" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="contract" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;" target="l1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="l1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;" target="l2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="l2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;" target="l3"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="l3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;" target="l4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="l4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;" target="l5"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e6" edge="1" parent="1" source="l3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" target="model" value="发现"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e7" edge="1" parent="1" source="l4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" target="ext" value="决策"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e8" edge="1" parent="1" source="l5" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;strokeColor=#64748b;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1e293b;" target="peer" value="调用"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
